FOSTER CITY, Calif., Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sagimet Biosciences Inc. (Nasdaq: SGMT), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapeutics targeting dysfunctional metabolic and fibrotic pathways, today announced that management will participate in two upcoming investor conferences.


- Cantor 2026 Global Healthcare Conference in New York, NY on Wednesday, September 9, 2026, with a fireside chat at 1.35pm ET (link[here](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/r01/___https:/sqps.onstreamsecure.com/origin/enliven/players/EnlivenPlayer.html?customerId=22&eventId=85710161&checkCompany=1&checkEmail=1&checkName=1___.YzJ1OnNhZ2ltZXRiaW9zY2llbmNlczpjOm86ZDg3MGQ2NDJiOWNiY2ZlY2MzZmFiYzgzZmQxMGNmNDc6Nzo1MDg4OmE2ZWNhMGQ3ODgzNmNhNGYyYWQwNzQxMmFjZGQ5ZWE5YWExNmI3MmE2YTRlY2JkYjAzOTg2NjQ1ODJhZWY2Nzc6aDpUOkY) ).
- H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference in New York, NY on Monday, September 14, 2026.


The fireside chat will be available in the Investors & Media section of Sagimet’s website at[www.sagimet.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=D7A5wFGflB2S255iUXzlurkNoHW5lDtmy9j-KazZxv8ZLxuqQu3Iv7h1FbXNHmDPkmvM7LzKANimqMqq7joCW66i7broE67F1-EMN-LTu8c=) , with an archived replay available for 90 days following the live event.


**About Sagimet Biosciences**


Sagimet is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel FASN inhibitors designed to target dysfunctional metabolic and fibrotic pathways in conditions resulting from the overproduction of the fatty acid, palmitate. FASN is a regulator of lipid synthesis, a key pathway implicated in multiple diseases, such as acne, MASH and certain FASN-dependent tumor types. For additional information about Sagimet, please visit[www.sagimet.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=D7A5wFGflB2S255iUXzlur-ebasPK0uwYvw9jKppBs-4Nvlmhibaixz_XRgPrYoDYzanYaVi6ye6DxqH_M9eS3NgIhV2sPcdBvNxUrygffk=) .
